channel.title: Lucas Santos: now
channel.description: What Lucas Santos is doing now, one item per update of the /now page

item.title: Now: updated 2026-09-29
item.description:
This is a now page, a snapshot of what I'm up to and what's on my mind right now. We are not static beings and our interests shift over time, this page is a reflection of that.

You can check how I change over time on this page's Git repo.

Focus

  • Electronics, learning how to design and build guitar pedals and other small electronics
  • My Node.js book, I am currently finishing it and will be publishing it soon
  • My blog, I am trying to post more often, but I have been busy with other things

Philosophy

  • Pondering about my relationship with technology and AI recently. And rethinking my entire career and what I really liked to do since I was a kid.

Hobbies

  • I do photos from time to time, I post most of them in Unsplash
  • I recently got into listening to Vinyl again, I have a small collection of records and I am trying to get more, mostly 70s rock (Toto is one of my favorites) and metal, but I do love blues
  • I'm Learning electronics by myself, building guitar pedals and designing some PCBs in KiCad
  • Learning CAD so I can enclose these PCBs into something 3D printed, which, I am also a noob at
  • Continuing my studies on music, trying to understand how this whole thing works

Books

  • The Stars, Like Dust, by Isaac Asimov
  • Practical Electronics for Inventors, by Paul Scherz and Simon Monk

Music

  • Learning
    • Pride and Joy, by Steve Ray Vaughan, on the Bass.
    • Square Hammer, by Ghost, on the Guitar
  • Currently looping Stela Cole on Spotify

Games

  • No Man's Sky
  • Elite Dangerous
